chore: use simp instead of norm_num where simp suffices #43035

has gone through quite a few rounds of merge conflicts, could I please have a decision?
We have merged similar PRs before: I think this PR is good to merge in principle. (I may not have time to review the diff today, but I could push the button if it were maintainer merged.)
I don't have the ability to maintainer merge, but I can confirm with a simple git diff master --word-diff=plain that the only changes here are literal replacements of norm_num to simp.
